description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing updates, git checkouts, version resolution, and command execution within the openclaw project. It includes functions for resolving package versions, checking git repositories, running commands with timeouts, and handling update steps.

methods.name: parseTimeoutMsOrExit
methods.description: Parses a timeout string into milliseconds, exits process if invalid.

methods.name: resolveTargetVersion
methods.description: Resolves the target version of a package based on a tag, possibly fetching from npm registry.

methods.name: isGitCheckout
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a git checkout by looking for a .git folder.

methods.name: isCorePackage
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a core package by reading its package.json name.

methods.name: isEmptyDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty.

methods.name: resolveGitInstallDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for git installation, considering environment override.

methods.name: resolveUpdateRoot
methods.description: Resolves the root directory for updates, based on package root or current working directory.

methods.name: runUpdateStep
methods.description: Runs a command with timeout, tracks progress, and returns execution result.

methods.name: ensureGitCheckout
methods.description: Ensures a directory is a git checkout, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: resolveGlobalManager
methods.description: Detects and returns the global install manager (npm or other) for a given root.

methods.name: tryWriteCompletionCache
methods.description: Attempts to write command completion cache by executing a script.

methods.name: createGlobalCommandRunner
methods.description: Creates a command runner function that executes commands with timeout.
